newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wang On issues HK$50 mln convertible note.
newsitem.headline: Wang On issues HK$50 mln convertible note.

text.p: Wang On Group Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to issue to professional and institutional investors a HK$50 million convertible note convertible into Wang On shares at a price of HK$1.50 per share.
The company said it had granted the placing manager Sun Hung Kai International Ltd an option to require Wang On to issue up to a total HK$66 million notes in case of oversubscription.
Assuming full conversion of the HK$66 million notes, a total of 44 million new shares representing 19.54 percent of the company's existing share capital will be issued, it said.
The notes will bear interest of 7.5 percent per annum and will be payable semi-annually, it said.
The decoration and construction services concern said proceeds from the issue would be used to finance expansion and investment plans and for working capital.
Its shares ended HK$0.05 up at HK$2.50 each on Tuesday.
